attack_strategy: Impersonate an authorized address (owner) and call UpdateTaxes with buyTax = 25, which exceeds the MaxTax limit of 20. Then verify that _buyTax > 20.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call UpdateTaxes with buyTax = 25 and other taxes that sum to 100. 4. Call getTaxes() to verify _buyTax is now > 20.
